item.title: Morning Routine
item.dc:creator: Hilmi Billah
item.description: There’s something quietly magical about the first hour of the morning, before the emails start rolling in and the world demands your attention. I’ve spent the past few months experimenting with how I use that time, and the results have surprised me.

item.title: Checking out without the hassle: what customers expect in 2026
item.dc:creator: Dries De Smedt
item.description: On payment methods, drop-off moments and why the checkout of your webshop matters as much as your shop window. What customers expect in 2026, and how to build a payment flow that does not get in the way.
